name: plot-templates
summary: Generate a plot from a target file — canned templates first, agent fallback (in-process)
description: Single-stage plotting workflow. The processor (pennsieve-quick-plot) dispatches in-process between a deterministic per-format template (cheap, ~5s when `template` is set + known) and an LLM agent loop (~30s when `template` is unset, unknown, or the canned render failed). Mounts the `quick-plot-stack` EFS layer for the scientific Python deps both paths need.
